title: epiphyllum strictum
intro: Epiphyllum strictum, commonly known as the Queen of the Night or Night-Blooming Cereus, is a type of flowering cactus that is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its fragrant, white flowers that bloom at night and have a strong, sweet scent, attracting pollinators such as moths and bats. The health benefits of Epiphyllum strictum include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve sleep quality due to its sedative and anti-anxiety properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects.
